notes: Claude sketches are free: no API key needed, use your regular Claude account
An API key is still optional for drawing without leaving the app
Claude sketches now work with every extension version, so there's nothing to reinstall
Sketch-only: every background is a minimal line drawing in one shared look; photo search, web downloads and AI image generators are removed
Surprise me: new mountain ranges, ocean waves, skylines, constellations and planets made on your computer
Ask Claude in your own words, including words to show (e.g. a lighthouse with the words STAY STRONG)
Look: neon glow in 6 colors, white on black, or black on white; word above or below; draw-in animation on/off
Clock: corner, centered at top, large in the middle, or hidden; 24-hour, date and seconds options
Library: change any sketch's word; old photos from earlier versions can be deleted
Clearer message when Claude sketches need a newer extension: shows the extension version Edge is running and how to update it
Black-on-white sketches stay pure white (the Darken setting now only affects photos)
Crisper sketch thumbnails in the picker and library
Tidier settings page: no blank gaps under the search filters and Claude box
Clearer welcome screen on an empty new tab
Sketch anything with Claude: name any subject and Claude draws it in the same simple line style
Claude's drawings join your sketch picker and work in all three looks
Uses your own Anthropic API key; Eco mode uses Claude Haiku; brands become plain objects, never logos
Fix: long sketch lines now draw in completely
Minimal sketches: simple line drawings that draw themselves in, then stay still (no AI, no downloads)
9 subjects: Cybertruck, light-cycle, airliner, monorail, city skyline, castle on a cliff, drone, fighter jet, mountains
3 looks: neon blue on black, white on black, black on white, plus an optional word like FOCUS
On sketch backgrounds, the clock and search move to a slim top bar
Search filters: scenes instead of close-ups of faces (on by default)
Online stores, marketplaces and stock-photo sellers are skipped (on by default)
Blocked sites: add any website you never want photos from
Search shows how many results your filters hid
Emergency stop: toolbar button, Alt+Shift+X shortcut, and a Stop button in settings
Control Center: choose what the app can access, see an activity log, approve code updates
Eco mode: lighter AI images, 5 AI images a day, fewer background downloads
Up to 1,000 photos per auto-rotating search
